_leia: Lote de arte (tools/arte_lote.py): ícones das 6 cartas novas, retratos refeitos (Gordinho, Bandoleiro, Galgo, cacto, monstera) e 2 personagens novos (referência ao Catan e o cavalo do xadrez). Textos em inglês porque o gerador entende melhor.

pausa.texto: Pausa card: skip your turn without taking a die. A steaming cream teacup on a small saucer, a cozy break.
variantes: Pausa card (skip your turn, a calm break): a steaming cream teacup on a small saucer with a honey band, one curl of steam.
Pausa card (skip your turn): a round sage-green token with two thick vertical cream pause bars on it.
Pausa card (skip your turn): an open hand raised palm forward, saying 'wait', warm skin tone, simple mitten-like shape.

reverso.texto: Reverso card: your dice chain now grows from the other end.
variantes: Reverso card (reverse your dice chain): a short horizontal row of three small ivory dice with one thick sky-blue U-turn arrow looping over them from right back to left.
Reverso card (reverse the chain): one thick lavender U-turn arrow, chunky and bold, nothing else.
Reverso card (reverse the chain): two thick arrows, honey and sky blue, pointing in opposite directions, stacked, like a swap sign.

furto.texto: Furto card: swap your pocket die with the rival's pocket die.
variantes: Furto card (swap pockets with the rival): two small drawstring cloth pouches, one coral and one sky blue, with two curved arrows crossing between them.
Furto card (steal the rival's pocket die): a sly gloved hand pulling a small ivory die out of a coral drawstring pouch.
Furto card (pocket swap): a coral drawstring pouch wearing a tiny black bandit eye mask, cheeky, a die peeking out.

convite.texto: Convite card: the rival must take the die you choose.
variantes: Convite card (an invitation the rival must accept): a cream envelope, flap open, with a small ivory die peeking out of it. No wax seal.
Convite card (you choose the die the rival must take): a hand presenting a single ivory die on an open palm, like an offering.
Convite card (forced invitation): a small honey-gold ticket with a die printed on it, slightly tilted. No text.

lacre.texto: Lacre trap card: cancels the rival's next effect card.
variantes: Lacre trap (seals and cancels the rival's next effect): a round coral-red wax seal with a simple embossed star and drippy wax edges.
Lacre trap (cancels the next effect): a small sage-green padlock, chunky and closed.
Lacre trap (seal that cancels a card): a cream card seen from the front with a big coral-red wax seal stamped on its center. No text on the card.

ampulheta.texto: Ampulheta trap card: you score 3 if the rival holds his chain instead of firing.
variantes: Ampulheta trap (punishes the rival for waiting): a wooden hourglass with honey-gold sand flowing, chunky wooden caps.
Ampulheta trap (punishes waiting, a points card): a wooden hourglass with honey sand and one tiny gold lightning spark beside it.
Ampulheta trap: a slim glass hourglass with lavender sand and brass caps, slightly tilted.

gordinho.texto: SPECIAL. Gordinho: a friendly, likable chubby American guy (fair skin, rosy cheeks, round face, small round nose), shown from the head down to the round belly. HAIR, very important: short brown hair covering the back and the sides of the head and most of the top; at the front of the hairline there is a small central forelock tuft, and on each side of that tuft a receding bald 'entrada' (two deep temple recessions forming an M-shaped hairline). NOT bald on top, NO single curl, NO topknot, NO pigtail. Big open friendly eyes with visible irises and eyebrows (not narrow slits, not closed), a warm wide smile. Light-blue button shirt stretched over the belly, hands resting on the belly. Kind Midwestern dad energy, cute and lovable, never a caricature.
variantes: SPECIAL. Gordinho: a friendly, likable chubby American guy (fair skin, rosy cheeks, round face, small round nose), shown from the head down to the round belly. NOT bald on top, NO single curl, NO topknot, NO pigtail. Big open friendly eyes with visible irises and eyebrows, a warm wide smile. Light-blue button shirt stretched over the belly, hands resting on the belly. Cute and lovable, never a caricature.

SPECIAL. Gordinho: a jolly chubby American man in his forties (fair skin, freckles, rosy cheeks, round face), head down to the round belly. HAIR: brown, short, with an M-shaped receding hairline: two bald temple recessions and a small tuft of hair in the middle front; hair everywhere else on top and sides. NOT bald on top, NO single curl, NO pigtail. Open bright eyes with irises, raised friendly eyebrows, a cheeky grin, one hand giving a thumbs up and the other on the belly. Light-blue short-sleeve button shirt.

SPECIAL. Gordinho: a sweet chubby American guy (fair skin, rosy cheeks, double chin, round face), head down to the round belly. HAIR: light brown, an M-shaped receding hairline (two bald temple recessions on the forehead, a small rounded tuft at the center front), hair on top and sides. NOT bald on top, NO curl, NO pigtail. Big open eyes with irises looking at the viewer, a slightly mischievous smile with one raised eyebrow. Light-blue button shirt stretched over the belly with one button almost popping, hands on the belly.

bandoleiro.texto: SPECIAL. Change only the mouth: remove the gold tooth and the yellow mark at the corner of the mouth; the mouth is a clean sly grin with no tooth and no mark. Keep the hat with the playing card, the wink, the thin curled mustache, the red neckerchief, the slate-blue coat and the medallion exactly as they are.

galgo.texto: SPECIAL. Galgo, a shrewd and witty anthropomorphic greyhound seen STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, facing the viewer, symmetrical: long narrow muzzle seen head-on (foreshortened, the nose at the center of the face), rose ears folded back on both sides, slate-gray short coat with a white blaze running down the center of the face, narrowed amber eyes with a knowing look and slanted brows, a faint confident smirk, wide red martingale collar with a small gold tag. NOT in profile, NOT three-quarter view.
variantes: SPECIAL. Galgo, a shrewd and witty anthropomorphic greyhound seen STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT, facing the viewer, symmetrical: long narrow muzzle seen head-on (foreshortened, the black nose at the center of the face), rose ears folded back on both sides, slate-gray short coat with a white blaze down the center of the face, narrowed amber eyes with a knowing look, a faint confident smirk, wide red martingale collar with a small gold tag. NOT in profile, NOT three-quarter view.

SPECIAL. Galgo, a clever gentleman greyhound, front view facing the viewer, symmetrical: slender head, narrow muzzle pointing at the viewer, ears folded back like little rose petals, slate-gray coat, white chest and white blaze down the face, half-lidded amber eyes and one eyebrow raised, a small knowing smile, red collar with a gold tag. NOT in profile.

SPECIAL. Galgo, a witty greyhound with a slate-gray coat seen from the front, looking straight at the viewer: long elegant muzzle foreshortened toward the viewer, folded-back ears, white blaze, amber eyes narrowed in amusement, confident smirk, a red bow tie instead of the collar. NOT in profile.

cacto.texto: A cheerful little cactus character in a playful running pose, inspired by classic JRPG cactus creatures: a tall rounded green cactus body with soft vertical ribs, two short arms raised at different heights, two little legs mid-stride, a simple face of two black dot eyes and a small round 'o' mouth, three tiny tufts of spines on top. Standing on a tiny patch of sand. No pot.
variantes: A cheerful little cactus character in a playful running pose, inspired by classic JRPG cactus creatures: a tall rounded green cactus body with soft vertical ribs, one arm raised up and the other bent down, two little legs mid-stride, a simple face of two black dot eyes and a small round 'o' mouth, three tiny tufts of spines on top. A small shadow of sand under its feet. No pot.

A cute cactus creature striking a dynamic dance pose (arms up and down, one knee raised), smooth bright green body, simple face with two black dot eyes and an open round mouth, a tiny pink flower on its head. No pot.
A small green cactus character sprinting to the side but facing the viewer, arms swinging, body slightly leaning, dot eyes and an 'o' mouth, a few spine tufts. Simple, iconic, friendly. No pot.

monstera.texto: A monstera deliciosa houseplant in a terracotta pot: three large glossy heart-shaped leaves with the characteristic deep side splits and a few oval holes (fenestrations), sage and deep green, leaves fanning out. No face.
variantes: A monstera deliciosa houseplant in a terracotta pot: three large glossy heart-shaped leaves with the characteristic deep side splits and a few oval holes (fenestrations), sage and deep green, leaves fanning out. No face.
A single big monstera leaf, heart-shaped with deep splits and holes, standing in a small terracotta pot with a cream band, plus one small young rolled leaf. No face.
A lush monstera in a round cream ceramic pot, four split leaves of different sizes, clearly recognizable monstera fenestrations. No face.

catan.texto: SPECIAL. A homage to classic hex-tile settlement board games (no logo, no text, no branded art).
variantes: SPECIAL. A fluffy cream sheep character with a friendly face standing on a single green hexagonal board-game tile, a tiny wheat sheaf beside it. Homage to hex-tile settlement board games. No logo, no text.

SPECIAL. A friendly settler character: a simple rounded wooden board-game pawn (meeple-like) painted brick red, with a small smiling face, holding a sheaf of golden wheat, standing on a hexagonal tile. No logo, no text.
SPECIAL. A charming robber pawn character: a dark gray turned-wood game pawn with a sly friendly face and a tiny bandit mask, standing on a sandy desert hexagon tile. No logo, no text.

cavalo.texto: SPECIAL. Cavalo: the knight chess piece as a character.
variantes: SPECIAL. Cavalo: a classic wooden knight chess piece as a character, polished walnut wood, carved horse head with a flowing mane, one friendly clever eye, round base. Facing the viewer at a slight angle as chess knights do. No text.
SPECIAL. Cavalo: an ivory knight chess piece with a noble, witty expression, carved mane, round base with a thin gold ring, a tiny smile. No text.
SPECIAL. Cavalo: a dark ebony knight chess piece with a bold confident look, carved mane highlighted in warm wood, one eye shining, round base. No text.
